test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On basis of the information given in the passage, which of following statement is NOT correct?

options.text: Tsar Nicholas II was much more interested in matters of the state than his family life.
Peasants maintained the majority of the population in Russia.
There was a population boom in Russia from 1867-1896.
The series of war caused great discontent among the people and caused suffering in the Russia's economy and government.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explicitly states that Tsar Nicholas II was much more interested in his family life, than matters of the state. So, 'Option 1' contradicts this information and hence is incorrect.
 
• 'Option 2' is directly supported by the passage which says peasants were the majority population in Russia.
 
• 'Option 3' is correct as the passage mentions that there was a population boom in Russia from 1867-1896.
 
• 'Option 4' is also accurate as it reflects how the consecutive wars caused great discontent among the people and strain on the economy and government.

Therefore, the correct answer is - **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The not correct statement (Option 1) reversed the fact stated in the passage about Tsar Nicholas II's priorities, making it inaccurate.
 
• The other three options directly mirror the information given in the reading, validating them as true reflections of the passage.
